result.title: PRISM: Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling to Enhance Solubility OOD Generalization
result.summary: Solubility depends on intermolecular interactions between solutes and solvents, and is central to drug discovery, chemical and materials process engineering. Its prediction requires out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to unseen solutes, solvents, and solvent mixtures, where supervised methods suffer from data scarcity, and existing self-supervised methods do not explicitly learn chemically meaningful relations. Learning chemically meaningful relational information without labels can alleviate data scarcity and improve OOD generalization, but remains challenging. We introduce Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling (PRISM) and apply it to solubility OOD generalization. PRISM is a label-free pretraining framework that converts expert-defined chemical priors into relational teachers. For solubility prediction, it trains four encoders to preserve the population-level relational information from priors capturing hydrophobic, electrostatic, polarizability, and substructural effects, using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to match distance-based neighborhood distributions during pretraining. Across scaffold, solute, and solvent OOD settings, PRISM matches or surpasses supervised and self-supervised baselines. Under mixed-solvent OOD, freezing the four PRISM encoders and training a lightweight fusion-and-composition head outperforms strong baselines and substantially reduces run-to-run variation. Ablations and control studies confirm that gains stem from chemically meaningful relational structures baked into the encoders by PRISM. We expect this strategy of turning relational priors into self-supervision signals to extend beyond solubility prediction to domains where chemically or biologically meaningful relational priors are available.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 PRISM，把专家定义的化学先验（疏水、静电、极化、子结构）转化为关系型教师信号，用 KL 散度匹配基于距离的邻域分布来无标签预训练四个编码器，以提升溶解度预测在未见溶质、溶剂及混合溶剂上的 OOD 泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把关系先验转成自监督信号、约束编码器保留邻域关系结构」的做法，可能与 LVR 中如何让内部状态保留实体与几何关系、以及表示几何的监督方式存在可核查的类比线索，但领域相距较远，仅为潜在启发。
